description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1561/18 of 06.08.2008 Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific corrections to land parcel records, including changes to land extent measurements, expunging of particulars, and modifications to encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, title amendments, and property record corrections.
